en.t: It did not look as though they meant any harm.

units.source_text: 但他们像是时刻提防着什么事——大概县公所的人预定要来调查吧。

en.t: But they seemed to be constantly on guard against something, probably because someone from the county office was scheduled to come and investigate.

units.source_text: 眼下，警报解除了，他们不过是善良的一介渔夫而已。

en.t: For the moment, the alarm had been lifted, and they were nothing more than ordinary, good-natured fishermen.
